title: Sample: Why Slow WhatsApp Replies Cost You Sales
description: Customers message several businesses at once and buy from whoever answers first. Here is how to close that gap.
content:
## The customer who messaged you at 9pm

Someone sees your product, sends a message, and waits. If you are asleep, in a meeting or busy with another customer, they do not wait for long. They message the next business on the list.

This is the quiet way small businesses lose sales: not to a better product, but to a faster reply.

## Why speed matters more than you think

People message several businesses at once and usually buy from the first one that gives a clear answer. A reply that comes the next morning is often too late.

### The usual ways owners cope

- Keeping the phone in hand all day, every day
- Hiring someone just to answer repetitive questions
- Replying in batches and hoping nobody has moved on

None of these scale, and all of them cost you time you should spend running the business.

## What an AI agent changes

A custom AI agent on WhatsApp can answer at any hour, remember each customer's conversation and pass real buyers to you with a summary.

| Without an agent | With an agent |
|---|---|
| Replies when you are free | Replies right away, day or night |
| Repeats the same answers all day | Handles common questions on its own |
| Forgets who said what | Remembers each conversation |

## What to do next

Start by listing the five questions your customers ask most. Those are the first things an agent can handle. If you want to see how that would work for your business, ask Alfred.

title: Sample: Custom AI Agent vs Meta AI for Your Business
description: Meta AI can answer general questions. A custom agent knows your business. Here is the difference and why it matters.
content:
## Short answer

Meta AI is a general assistant. A custom AI agent is built around **your** business: your products, your prices, your tone and your way of following up. That difference decides whether it actually helps you sell.

## Where a general assistant falls short

- It does not know your inventory or how you answer common questions
- It does not keep a memory of each customer for your business
- It does not follow up with people who went quiet
- It does not hand you a clean summary of who is ready to buy

## What a custom agent does instead

A custom agent is trained on your business information. It replies in your style, remembers returning customers and passes serious buyers to you.

> The goal is not to replace you. It is to make sure no customer waits and no lead is forgotten.

### A simple way to compare

| | General assistant | Custom agent |
|---|---|---|
| Knows your business | No | Yes |
| Remembers customers | No | Yes |
| Follows up | No | Yes |
| Lead summaries for you | No | Yes |

## Which one do you need?

If customers only ask you general questions, a general assistant may be enough. If they ask about *your* products, prices and availability, you need something built for you.

## What to do next

Tell Alfred what you sell and how customers usually reach you. He can show you what a custom agent would handle for your business. You can also see how pricing works on our [pricing page](/pricing).

title: Sample: How a WhatsApp Agent Sells Phones From a Google Sheet
description: A look at how a phone vendor's WhatsApp agent finds the exact phone, suggests options in budget and stays in sync with a simple sheet.
content:
## The problem phone vendors know too well

A customer asks for one exact phone. You have it, but you are busy, so the reply is slow. Or you reply with the wrong model. Either way, the sale slips.

## How the agent handles it

When a customer asks for a phone, the agent looks for **that exact model** in the vendor's inventory and shares the price. If it is not available, it suggests alternatives that fit the customer's budget.

### What the vendor controls

The inventory lives in a Google Sheet that the vendor edits directly. No code and no developer needed. When the sheet changes, the agent stays in sync.

- Add a new phone: add a row
- Change a price: edit the cell
- Hide something: use the visibility option

## Beyond answering questions

The agent also remembers customers who messaged before. When the vendor has a new offer, a promo or a discount, they can send it to those past contacts to remind them what the shop sells. It only goes to people who contacted the business first, and they can reply STOP at any time.

## What to do next

If you sell phones or gadgets, ask Alfred how this would work for your shop. You can also look at the [projects page](/projects) to see other agents we have built.
